crops.title_en: Games, Play, and Cultural Systems — four scholars, 20 dossiers
crops.subtitle_zh: Moretti 的尺度、Rusch 的意义、Parasecoli 的身份、Gobet 的专长：四条路径，一个关于「玩」的问题。
crops.subtitle_en: Moretti's scale, Rusch's meaning, Parasecoli's identity, Gobet's expertise: four routes into one question about play.
crops.lang_line_zh: 英/意/瑞/丹 × 20 — 核心书目经出版社/作者页/馆藏核对；未见全文者标 ◐/○
crops.lang_line_en: English / Italian / Swedish / Danish × 20 — core facts checked against publishers, author pages and catalogues; unread items marked ◐/○
crops.verdict_body_zh: 四圈二十书：尺度（Moretti 四书 + Jockers/Underwood）、意义（Rusch + Salen & Zimmerman/Bogost/Juul）、身份（Parasecoli 四书 + Mintz/Appadurai）、专长（Gobet 三书 + de Groot）。核心书目事实经出版社/作者页核对；未见全文者一律 ◐/○；相邻作品是语境，不是核心。
crops.verdict_body_en: Four rings, twenty dossiers: scale (four Moretti titles plus Jockers/Underwood), meaning (Rusch plus Salen & Zimmerman/Bogost/Juul), identity (four Parasecoli titles plus Mintz/Appadurai), expertise (three Gobet titles plus de Groot). Core facts checked against publishers and author pages; unread items marked ◐/○; adjacent works are context, not core.

verdict_gaps.zh: Parasecoli《The Pierogi Problem》的 ISBN/页数待核。
verdict_gaps.en: ISBN/pages of Parasecoli's The Pierogi Problem pending.

verdict_gaps.zh: 多数书未通读；20 部均已补概念/接受/局限/意图/长评，但仍未逐页通读。
verdict_gaps.en: Most books are unread; all 20 dossiers now carry concepts, reception, limits, author-intent and a critical essay, but none has been read page by page.

verdict_gaps.zh: 相邻作品（Jockers/Underwood/Salen & Zimmerman/Bogost/Juul/Mintz/Appadurai/de Groot）用于语境，不替代四家核心。
verdict_gaps.en: Adjacent works are context and do not replace the four core scholars.

crops.keel_zh: 下个窗口 2026-12 冬至 · Winter solstice

rings.label_zh: 第一圈 · 尺度（Moretti 四书 + 两本方法书）
rings.label_en: Ring 1 · Scale (four Moretti titles + two method books)
rings.note_zh: 从图/地图/树到「远读」，再到 Jockers 的宏观分析与 Underwood 的尺度反省。
rings.note_en: From graphs/maps/trees to distant reading, then Jockers's macroanalysis and Underwood's reflection on scale.

rings.label_zh: 第二圈 · 意义（Rusch + 游戏设计三书）
rings.note_zh: 从「深度游戏」到规则—玩耍—文化、程序修辞与半真实。
rings.note_en: From deep games to rules–play–culture, procedural rhetoric and half-reality.

rings.label_zh: 第三圈 · 身份（Parasecoli 四书 + 两本理论）
rings.label_en: Ring 3 · Identity (four Parasecoli titles + two theory books)
rings.note_zh: 从美食民族主义到全球布鲁克林、饺子问题与标签政治；Mintz/Appadurai 提供历史与理论纵深。
rings.note_en: From gastronativism to Global Brooklyn, the pierogi problem and label politics; Mintz/Appadurai supply history and theory.

rings.label_zh: 第四圈 · 专长（Gobet 三书 + de Groot）
rings.label_en: Ring 4 · Expertise (three Gobet titles + de Groot)
rings.note_zh: 从知觉/记忆到棋盘游戏心理学、普及版与经典出声思维研究。
rings.note_en: From perception/memory to board-game psychology, the popular version and the classic think-aloud study.

axes.label_zh: 尺度 · 从细读到远读
axes.label_en: scale · from close to distant reading
axes.note_zh: 一条从「模型」到「纲领」再到「操作/反省」的方法链。
axes.note_en: A method chain from models to programme to operationalisation/reflection.

axes.note_zh: 从「有意义的设计」到「规则如何论证」再到「半真实」。
axes.note_en: From design-for-meaning to how rules argue to half-reality.

axes.label_zh: 身份 · 食物如何划分归属
axes.note_zh: 从当代民族主义到城市审美、单一国家案例，再到历史与理论纵深。
axes.note_en: From contemporary nationalism to urban aesthetics, a single-nation case, and historical/theoretical depth.

axes.note_zh: 从普及导论回到学术比较，再到经典出声思维研究。
axes.note_en: From the popular introduction back to academic comparison and the classic think-aloud study.

reading_order.note_zh: 先各取一本可读的导论。
reading_order.note_en: One readable introduction from each cluster.

reading_order.note_zh: 把尺度、意义、身份、专长放在一起看。
reading_order.note_en: Read scale, meaning, identity and expertise together.

crops.title_zh: 围棋 · 观心、棋道与思想传统 · 十五书
crops.title_en: Go — Watching the Mind, the Way of the Board, and the Thought Tradition (15 dossiers)
crops.subtitle_zh: 四圈十五书：观心（Cobb）— 中国思想史（何云波）— 棋手自述与跨文化 — 原典（棋论与棋谱）；一本附录收拢其余提及文献。
crops.subtitle_en: Four rings, fifteen dossiers: contemplation (Cobb) — Chinese intellectual history (He Yunbo) — the player's account and cross-cultural studies — the classical sources. An appendix gathers the rest.
crops.lang_line_zh: 英/中/文言 × 15 — 核心书架经出版社/馆藏/书评核对；未见全文者标 ◐/○
crops.lang_line_en: English / Chinese / Classical × 15 — core shelf checked against publishers, catalogues and reviews; unread items marked ◐/○
crops.verdict_body_zh: 核心书架十五部覆盖四圈：观心（Cobb 三书）、中国思想史（何云波四书）、棋手自述与跨文化（吴清源 / Shotwell / Fairbairn–Hall / Moskowitz）、原典（《棋经十三篇》/《忘忧清乐集》/《玄玄棋经》）。书目事实经出版社、馆藏或书评核对；未见全文的解读一律 ◐/○；原清单标为待核的篇名不升级。
crops.verdict_body_en: The fifteen dossiers cover four rings: contemplation (three Cobb titles), Chinese intellectual history (four He Yunbo titles), the player's account and cross-cultural studies (Wu, Shotwell, Fairbairn–Hall, Moskowitz), and the classical sources (Thirteen Chapters, Carefree Collection, Gateway). Publication facts are checked against publishers, catalogues or reviews; unread interpretations stay ◐/○; titles marked unverified in the source list are not upgraded.

verdict_gaps.zh: Cobb《佛教哲学与围棋》仅单一书目来源（2021），出版社 / ISBN / 与 2005 年文集的重合度待核。
verdict_gaps.en: Cobb's Buddhist Philosophy rests on a single 2021 listing; publisher, ISBN and overlap with the 2005 collection are pending.

verdict_gaps.zh: 何云波四书的版次 / 年份 / ISBN 未逐一核实（书名与作者已由湘潭大学官网确认）。
verdict_gaps.en: Editions, years and ISBNs of He Yunbo's four books are not individually verified (titles and authorship are confirmed via Xiangtan University).

verdict_gaps.zh: 《玄玄棋经》编纂者 / 版本待核；《棋经十三篇》十三篇全目与宋本原貌待核。
verdict_gaps.en: The Gateway's compiler and editions are pending; the full thirteen chapter-titles and the Song original of the Qijing are pending.

verdict_gaps.zh: Moskowitz《Go Nation》正文未读，ISBN / 页数待核（出版社页 403）。
verdict_gaps.en: Moskowitz's Go Nation is unread; ISBN/pages pending (publisher page 403).

verdict_gaps.zh: 原清单中的「静坐 / 记录情绪 / 弃子观照 / 收盘观无常」是实践建议，不是上述作者的原文或成套行法，未写入正文。
verdict_gaps.en: The source list's 'sitting / recording emotions / contemplating sacrifice / closing as impermanence' are practice suggestions, not the authors' verified teachings; they are kept out of the body text.

crops.keel_zh: 下个窗口 2026-12 冬至 · Winter solstice

rings.label_zh: 第一圈 · 观心（Cobb 三书）
rings.label_en: Ring 1 · Watching the mind (three Cobb titles)
rings.note_zh: 从哲学随笔到佛教原理，再到入门教材：把「观心 Cobb」与「教学 Cobb」分开。
rings.note_en: From philosophical essays to Buddhist principles to the primer: separate the contemplative Cobb from the teacher.

rings.label_zh: 第二圈 · 中国思想史（何云波四书）
rings.label_en: Ring 2 · Chinese intellectual history (four He titles)
rings.note_zh: 思想史—棋论选—文化—文艺精神：先建框架，再回到文献。
rings.note_en: Intellectual history — selected treatises — culture — literary-artistic spirit: build the frame, then return to the documents.

rings.label_zh: 第三圈 · 棋手自述与跨文化
rings.label_en: Ring 3 · The player's account & cross-cultural studies
rings.note_zh: 吴清源的「中和」— Shotwell 的教学与文化 — Fairbairn/Hall 的历史 — Moskowitz 的人类学。
rings.note_en: Wu's equilibrium — Shotwell's teaching and culture — Fairbairn/Hall's history — Moskowitz's anthropology.

rings.label_zh: 第四圈 · 原典（棋论与棋谱）
rings.note_zh: 《棋经十三篇》—《忘忧清乐集》—《玄玄棋经》：从论到谱，再到死活题。
rings.note_en: Thirteen Chapters — Carefree Collection — Gateway: from theory to records to problems.

axes.label_zh: 观心 · 从执著到放下
axes.note_zh: 佛教觉悟（Cobb）与中和和谐（吴清源）是两条不同的「超越胜负」路径，不可混为一谈。
axes.note_en: Buddhist enlightenment (Cobb) and equilibrium-harmony (Wu) are two different routes beyond winning; do not conflate them.

axes.label_zh: 中国思想 · 儒道与技进乎道
axes.note_zh: 从现代思想史回到古典棋论：看「立象比德」「技进乎道」如何在文本中成立。
axes.note_en: From modern intellectual history back to the classical treatise: see how imaging virtue and skill-into-Way actually work in the text.

axes.label_zh: 原典与谱系 · 从棋论到死活
axes.label_en: sources & genealogy · from theory to problems
axes.note_zh: 棋论、古谱、死活题三种文本形态；不要把题集读成人生寓言。
axes.note_en: Three textual forms — treatise, record, problem collection; do not read a problem collection as a life allegory.

reading_order.note_zh: 先规则，再问题意识，再古典语法。
reading_order.note_en: Rules first, then the question, then the classical grammar.

reading_order.note_zh: 观心、自述、原典各取一本。
reading_order.note_en: One from contemplation, one from the player's account, one from the sources.

reading_order.note_zh: 把美学、历史与社会科学的对照读进来。
reading_order.note_en: Bring in aesthetics, history and the social-science counterweight.

crops.verdict_body_zh: 特辑八册与第二圈主干均已回源定位版本（✓/◐）。本轮又订正三处书目错误：《日本色气》所收阿部次郎篇为《德川时代的文艺与社会》（1931），不是《贞操的理想》；《妄想者手记》并未收入《侏儒的话》，封面副题与内容不符；《异国放浪记》是《美利坚物语》与《法兰西物语》的合辑题名，不是荷风原书名。八册的篇目已成表；仍存疑处逐条标 ◐/○。
crops.verdict_body_en: The eight core volumes and Ring 2's spine are all edition-located (✓/◐). This pass corrected three more bibliographic errors: the Abe Jiro text in Iki is Arts and Society of the Tokugawa Era (1931), not The Ideal of Chastity; the Akutagawa selection does not contain Dwarf's Words despite its subtitle; and Ikoku Roro-ki is an editorial title for American Stories plus French Stories, not an original Nagai title. Contents for all eight are now tabulated; open points are marked ◐/○.

verdict_gaps.zh: 《日本色气》所收阿部篇已定为《德川时代的文艺与社会》（1931），后编篇目据中译目录列二题；日文原书后编未逐条核对。
verdict_gaps.en: The Abe text in the iki omnibus is Arts and Society of the Tokugawa Era (1931); part two is listed from the Chinese contents as two items, and the Japanese original has not been checked item by item.

verdict_gaps.zh: 大西《物哀》仅得 Marra 2001 文集中的英译节选，未见单行英译；书目待续查。
verdict_gaps.en: Onishi's Mono no Aware survives in English only as an excerpt in Marra 2001; no standalone translation found.

verdict_gaps.zh: 《濹东绮谭》中译页数与印次待据原书补录；《侏儒的话》为另一文本，逐字引文须先取得授权或核对原书。
verdict_gaps.en: Bokuto Kidan's Chinese page count awaits the book; Dwarf's Words is a separate text, and verbatim lines need a licence or a checked copy.

verdict_gaps.zh: 《妄想者手记》的选目标准未说明；《异国放浪记》下册单册 ISBN 未独立显示。
verdict_gaps.en: The Akutagawa selection's criteria are unstated; the Nagai vol. 2 ISBN is not shown independently.

verdict_gaps.zh: 外围书目不抄豆瓣评分，只标存在性；特辑套装评分 8.2/8.9 两值以各册页为准。
verdict_gaps.en: Peripheral titles carry existence marks, not Douban scores; the set's 8.2/8.9 split defers to each volume page.

rings.label_zh: 第一圈 · 特辑本体（八册）
rings.note_zh: 北京联合「日本文化特辑（第一辑）」，以「日本美学关键词」丛书为骨：思想史（分身）—美学（摩灭／侘寂／色气／粹）—文学手记（荷风／漱石／芥川）。荷风《放浪记》分上下册，合为八。
rings.note_en: Beijing United's Japan Culture Special (Vol. 1), built on the Japanese Aesthetic Keywords series: thought-history (Avatar), aesthetics (masshitsu, wabi-sabi, iki), literary notebooks (Kafu, Soseki, Akutagawa). Kafu's Wandering Diary counts as two volumes, making eight.

rings.label_zh: 第二圈 · 源头与对手（十六册）
rings.note_zh: 特辑只是这条长河的最近一段。往上游：每个美学关键词都有日文原典与英译通道；「日本是什么」由茶道、武士道、阴翳、徒然草、花传反复作答；「论日本」从黄遵宪、戴季陶到本尼迪克特、加藤周一，再到李永晶的《分身》。文豪侧翼回到荷风、漱石、芥川、川端的原文现场。
rings.note_en: The Special is only the nearest reach of one long river. Upstream, each aesthetic keyword has a Japanese original and an English channel; what Japan is gets answered again and again by tea, bushido, shadow, Essays in Idleness and the No treatise; Japan-ology runs Huang Zunxian, Dai Jitao, Benedict and Kato to Li Yongjing's Avatar. The literary wing returns to Kafu, Soseki, Akutagawa and Kawabata.

axes.label_zh: 思想史 · 谁在论日本
axes.note_zh: 从志书（黄遵宪）到策论（戴季陶），再到外视定型（本尼迪克特）、日本自评（加藤周一），最后收于中国认识论的反省（李永晶）。
axes.note_en: From gazetteer (Huang) to policy tract (Dai), to outside typing (Benedict) and Japanese self-assessment (Kato), closing on a Chinese epistemological reflection (Li).

axes.note_zh: 物哀（大西）→幽玄（世阿弥）→粹（九鬼）→侘寂（大西）→阴翳（谷崎）→摩灭（四方田）。六站各有一个可命名的范畴，也各有一位下定义的人。
axes.note_en: Aware (Onishi), yugen (Zeami), iki (Kuki), wabi-sabi (Onishi), shadow (Tanizaki), masshitsu (Yomota). Six stations, each with a nameable category and a definer.

axes.label_zh: 文学 · 从无常到空无
axes.note_zh: 徒然草（中世）→荷风（江户挽歌）→漱石（非人情）→芥川（箴语）→川端（空无）。五站之间是六百年的语气变化，不是进步。
axes.note_en: Tsurezuregusa, Kafu, Soseki, Akutagawa, Kawabata: six centuries of changing voice, not of progress.

reading_order.note_zh: 一本问「我们为何读日本」，一本给美学的概念底座，一本示范如何把日子写成文章。三本读完，全批的坐标就有了。
reading_order.note_en: One asks why we read Japan, one supplies the aesthetic base, one shows how to write a day into an essay. After three, the batch has coordinates.

reading_order.note_zh: 粹、侘寂、阴翳、摩灭：四个范畴，四种看世界的方式。读时不要急着统合，先让它们互相冲突。
reading_order.note_en: Iki, wabi-sabi, shadow, masshitsu: four categories, four ways of seeing. Do not harmonise them too soon; let them conflict.

reading_order.note_zh: 先走「甲」线（黄→戴→菊→加藤），再走「丙」线（荷风→芥川→川端）。一条问日本是什么，一条问美如何消逝。
reading_order.note_en: Take the intellectual line first (Huang, Dai, Benedict, Kato), then the literary line (Kafu, Akutagawa, Kawabata). One asks what Japan is, the other how beauty passes.

pointers.note_zh: 美学词的日语原文即其词根；先过五十音，再读原典。
pointers.note_en: The aesthetic terms' Japanese roots live there; clear the kana first, then the originals.

pointers.note_zh: 漱石、芥川、川端、谷崎、荷风五人的时代、师承与立场坐标。
pointers.note_en: Era, lineage and stance for Soseki, Akutagawa, Kawabata, Tanizaki and Kafu.

pointers.note_zh: 不同窗口，互不覆盖；其中一部日本书可与本批对读。
pointers.note_en: A different window, neither overwriting the other; one Japanese title can be read alongside.

pointers.note_zh: 其「文明通论」写法，可与《菊与刀》《杂种文化》作内视／外视对照。
pointers.note_en: Its civilisation-survey voice pairs with Benedict and Kato as an inside/outside contrast.

crops.subtitle_zh: 把论文与文章写好的四条根：清晰、认知、对话、诚信
crops.subtitle_en: Four roots of writing papers and articles well: clarity, cognition, conversation, integrity

crops.lang_line_en: English originals ×4 — the titles I could actually read (local / open-access) from the wr_ref canon
crops.verdict_body_zh: wr_ref.md 列出五层共 23 本「学术写作正典」。本轮只发布其中能合法取得原书并实际通读的四种；其余 19 本本地无原书、且无授权获取渠道，未做精读卡片——它们保留为待读正典（见下缺口）。
crops.verdict_body_en: wr_ref.md lists a 23-book, five-tier academic-writing canon. This round publishes only the four I could obtain an authorized original of and actually read; the other 19 have no local original and no licensed channel, so no read-through cards were made — they stay a to-read canon (see gaps).

verdict_gaps.zh: Tier 1 待读：Day & Gastel《How to Write and Publish a Scientific Paper》、Schimel《Writing Science》、Alley《The Craft of Scientific Writing》、Swales & Feak《Academic Writing for Graduate Students》
verdict_gaps.en: Tier 1 to read: Day & Gastel, Writing Science (Schimel), Craft of Scientific Writing (Alley), Academic Writing for Graduate Students (Swales & Feak)

verdict_gaps.zh: Tier 2 待读：Sword《Stylish Academic Writing》、Hayot《The Elements of Academic Style》、Swales & Feak《English in Today's Research World》、Clark《Writing Tools》
verdict_gaps.en: Tier 2 to read: Stylish Academic Writing (Sword), The Elements of Academic Style (Hayot), English in Today's Research World (Swales & Feak), Writing Tools (Clark)

verdict_gaps.zh: Tier 3 待读：Germano《Getting It Published》《From Dissertation to Book》、Luey《Handbook for Academic Authors》、Kelsky《The Professor Is In》
verdict_gaps.en: Tier 3 to read: Getting It Published & From Dissertation to Book (Germano), Handbook for Academic Authors (Luey), The Professor Is In (Kelsky)

verdict_gaps.zh: Tier 4 待读：Belcher、Silvia、Bolker、Goodson、Jensen（写作习惯与完成博士论文五书）
verdict_gaps.en: Tier 4 to read: Belcher, Silvia, Bolker, Goodson, Jensen (the five habit / dissertation-completion books)

verdict_gaps.zh: Tier 5 待读：Eco《How to Write a Thesis》
verdict_gaps.en: Tier 5 to read: How to Write a Thesis (Umberto Eco)

verdict_gaps.zh: 补充线索：写作正典可与「认知—清晰」（Pinker）及「对话—论证」（They Say）两条主轴继续向伦理/发表两端延展
verdict_gaps.en: Lead: extend the canon along its two axes — cognition/clarity (Pinker) and conversation/argument (They Say) — toward the ethics/publishing ends

crops.subtitle_zh: 从特洛伊到全球化 · 一套读完三千年欧洲
crops.subtitle_en: From Troy to the Global Age — three millennia in nine volumes
crops.lang_line_zh: 英国学术通史×9（英文原版）— 涵盖 1700BC–2017AD 全部时段
crops.verdict_body_zh: 供给完备——九卷覆盖企鹅欧洲史全套计划，时段无缝衔接（前1700–2017），作者皆为各领域顶级学者。唯一缺口：Vol.4 Grafton《Renaissance Europe》尚未出版（截至2026年9月为 forthcoming），实际可读八卷。
crops.verdict_body_en: Supply is complete — nine volumes cover the full Penguin History of Europe program, seamless period coverage (1700BC–2017AD), authors are top scholars in each field. Only gap: Vol.4 Grafton's Renaissance Europe remains forthcoming as of Sep 2026; eight volumes are practically readable.

verdict_gaps.zh: Vol.4 Grafton《Renaissance Europe》(1300–1517) 尚未面世——中世纪晚期到宗教改革的衔接段暂缺专著
verdict_gaps.en: Vol.4 Grafton, Renaissance Europe (1300–1517) still forthcoming — the late-medieval-to-Reformation bridge lacks a dedicated volume

verdict_gaps.zh: 可选补充：Norman Davies《Europe: A History》作单卷对照——鸟瞰与分卷互补
verdict_gaps.en: Optional add: Norman Davies, Europe: A History — a single-volume contrast to complement the multi-volume approach
